purpose: Independent semantic oracle for the first durable RocksDB event Admit consumer.

owner_selected_bindings.rule: Harness assigns concrete same-dataset QualifiedRefs and source identities before each scenario; symbolic names below are fixture bindings, not allocator order. Resolve every $binding:<name> to that scenario binding before constructing the typed descriptor.
owner_selected_bindings.event_dictionary_rule: No event mapping is preinstalled. First payload admission creates exactly one typed event mapping for the event ID in the same synced batch; its QualifiedRef, ordinal and source identity are owner-assigned.

unconstrained_owner_outputs: fact envelope recorded_at representation beyond the injected test clock
receipt bytes and dependency ordering consistent with the contract
